cache_adaptation.mask_cache: IconCache contains fixed owner-local slots holding fallibly allocated Vec<u8> masks; cloning an owner clones its data, clear drops only that owner’s data, and no global mutable state or unsafe code is used.
cache_adaptation.legacy_cache: Separate owner-local masks preserve the three frozen legacy painter geometries across theme/backing scale slots.
cache_adaptation.style_cache: The C 128-entry style-color memo is not ported because it memoizes a pure token lookup only; paint_state computes the identical token color directly. There is no output or lifetime difference.
cache_adaptation.allocation: All mask and segment buffers use try_reserve/try_reserve_exact and report IconError::Allocation; fixed tables and path strings are static data.

limits_and_errors.rgba: width/height must be nonzero; checked width*4, stride >= row bytes, checked height*stride <= mutable slice length; all validation occurs before writes.
limits_and_errors.tree: existing MAX_NODES/MAX_DEPTH/MAX_AXIS and text storage limits remain in force; user data stays owned by Tree/NodeSpec.

diagnostics.draw_api: PaintError::{NotLaidOut,InvalidBuffer,InvalidTree,Icon(IconError)}; IconError identifies invalid path, complexity cap, buffer, scale, id or allocation.
diagnostics.legacy_bool_contract: C false/zero outcomes become Result/Option in Rust. Input failures are validated before buffer writes; safe slices carry capacity and exclusive mutability.
